title: Washington Ecology anchors 50,000 treated gallons to 34 filled containers
summary: Washington Ecology's final permit-response record states that about 50,000 gallons had been treated and 34 containers filled as of February 2026. Denominator: A regulator-published dated operating snapshot linking approximate treated feed volume to a filled-container count, without inferring quality acceptance or disposal.
